scope: internal/events: the filters of a subscription that a start brings back
correction: A start restored each consumer with the filters the store held, and /nats admitted clients at once, while the first refilter ran a minute later. A grant change commits in the store before its hook runs, so a stop between the 2 left a consumer whose filter was wider than the grant, and a client could read events outside it. lodge now runs Restore before its first sweep: it refilters every restored subscription from the grant store, revokes a client it cannot read (fail closed), and admits no client until it has finished.
